base_member_text: [L50-L61] (MED/vcs-instructions) The Git example uses `git commit -a .` and `git push .`, which do not identify a normal commit message or remote and are likely unusable as written.
audit_member_text: [L60] (MED/invalid-git-command) The command git commit -a . combines automatic all-tracked-file selection with a pathspec, which Git rejects.
[L61,L79] (MED/incorrect-push-target) The push commands use . and somepage.rst as repository arguments, so they do not publish the commits to the cloned remote.
